page.overview:
What is Violetta Bulstrode?

Violetta Black (née Bulstrode) (fl. 1912-1920) was a pure-blood witch and a member of the Bulstrode family. She married Cygnus Black (II) and they had four children: Pollux, Cassiopeia, Marius, and Dorea Black. She may be related to Millicent Bulstrode as well.

is a version of the name Violet, derived from the flower. The name is well-known for being the stage name of a German-born circus performer born without legs or arms who was famous during the 1920s. The name Violetta could also be meant to mean, or be a reference to, the words violent or violence.

Bulstrode is an English surname that can refer to the medieval village of Bulstrode in Berkshire. It means either "the bull's marsh", or "the fort on the marsh". Therefore, Violetta's name could mean 'violent attitude or temper'.
